parameters.query:
SELECT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - 1)::text                              AS day,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE d = 1)::int                                          AS turns,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE d = 1 AND outcome = 'auto_send')::int                AS auto_send,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE d = 1 AND outcome = 'human_review')::int             AS human_review,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE d = 1 AND outcome = 'all_rejected')::int             AS all_rejected,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE d = 1 AND overridden)::int                           AS overridden,
       COALESCE(sum(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE d = 1), 0)                             AS total_cost,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) FILTER (WHERE d = 1) AS p95_latency_ms,
       avg(reviewer_score) FILTER (WHERE d = 1)                                    AS avg_reviewer_score,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE d = 2)::int                                          AS prev_turns,
       COALESCE(sum(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE d = 2), 0)                             AS prev_cost,
       COALESCE(fn_setting('DAILY_COST_WARN_USD')::numeric, 0)                     AS cost_warn_usd
FROM (
  SELECT outcome, overridden, cost_usd, latency_ms, reviewer_score,
         ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - (received_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date) AS d
  FROM conversation_turn_audit
  WHERE received_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - 2)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    AND received_at <  ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
) t;

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.n DESC), '[]'::json) AS intents
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(intent, 'unknown') AS intent, count(*)::int AS n
  FROM conversation_turn_audit
  WHERE received_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND received_at < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
  GROUP BY 1
) t;

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.n DESC), '[]'::json) AS reasons
FROM (
  SELECT reason, count(*)::int AS n
  FROM conversation_turn_audit a, unnest(a.routing_reasons) AS reason
  WHERE a.received_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND a.received_at < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
  GROUP BY reason
  ORDER BY n DESC
  LIMIT 5
) t;
